notes: 🧰 Work shifts: have a physical job? Set it up once (Train tab → Physical job?), then log a shift in seconds: hours, how hard it was and the weight you moved. You get the total you lifted and an estimated burn, and hard shifts now count toward your training load and readiness.
✨ With the Assistant on, describe a typical day and it sets the job up for you. The Assistant also takes your shifts into account.
